requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 当 D3 引脚的按钮按下时，让 D6 引脚的蜂鸣器持续发声。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: io_0 is false initially, then io_0 becomes true (button pressed) and stays true for multiple control steps, then io_0 becomes false (button released).
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: While io_0 is true, io_1 equals 1000 (Hz) at every control step; on the first control step after io_0 becomes false, io_1 equals 0 (Hz).
